title: Resignation - Arch-dev-public - lists.archlinux.org
excerpt: Yo, I'm resigning as a package maintainer and developer of Arch Linux. It's been almost a decade since I met Jelle, Chris, Levente and Remi at 33C3 to be (peacefully) coerced into joining the security team, and almost 9 years since I became a package maintainer. It's time to let go. I've sent an internal email about misc responsebilities people are free to taken over, but for the benefit of the list I'll point out that mkinitcpio and arch-install-scripts is currently left without an active maintainer. Thanks to all the friends I made along the way. # Orphaned packages Below is a list of packages that have me as the sole maintainer. I think the following packages should be adopted by someone. Rest can be cleaned up at some other point. 哟，我要辞去 Arch Linux 的软件包维护者和开发人员的职务。 自从我在 33C3 遇到 Jelle、Chris、Levente 和 Remi 并被（和平地）强迫加入安全团队以来，已经过去了近十年，距离我成为软件包维护者也已经过去了近 9 年。 是时候放手了。 我已经发送了一封关于杂项响应能力的内部电子邮件，人们可以自由地接管，但为了列表的利益，我将指出 mkinitcpio 和 arch-install-scripts 目前没有活跃的维护者。 感谢我一路上结识的所有朋友。 # 孤立的软件包 下面是我作为唯一维护者的软件包列表。 我认为以下软件包应该被某人采用。 休息可以在其他时间进行清理。 请注意，我没有检查依赖包。 - fsverity-utils - flatpak-xdg-utils - pesign - libmakepkg-dropins - wpa_supplicant - 所有 tpm2 软件包 λ ~ » pkgsearch -m Foxboron -l 1 acpid Age-plugin-tpm bmusbucklespring cilium-cli flatpak-xdg-utils fsverity-utils fusion-overlayfs gphoto2 grobi hy influx-cli influxdb jgmenu kakoune libmakepkg-dropins perl-anyevent-i3 perl-data-perl perl-gnupg-interface perl-moox-handlesvia perl-moox-late perl-strictures perl-sub-handlesvia perl-type-tiny pesign protege pwru python-adblock python-autobahn python-nltk python-pew python-pydbus python-pydocstyle python-pykka python-pypeg2 python-pytoolconfig python-pywal python-reportlab python-rope python-send2trash python-speaklater python-sphinx-autorun screenkey ssh-tpm-agent step-ca tpm2-pkcs11 tpm2-tools tpm2-totp tpm2-tss tpm2-tss-engine wpa_supplicant xdp-tools # 缺少共同维护者的软件包。 这是我认为需要另一个维护者的软件包列表。 - arch-install-scripts - archlinux-contrib - archlinux-keyring - archlinux-repro - debugedit - mkinitcpio - mkinitcpio-busybox - Bolt - nvme-cli - crun - gopls - go-tools - pacman - sbctl λ ~ » pkgsearch -m Foxboron -l 2 arch-install-scripts archlinux-contrib archlinux-keyring archlinux-repro b4 Bolt borg cni-plugins conmon crun debugedit delve dns-over-https docker-buildx git-lfs glider golangci-lint go-md2man gopls go-tools hexedit i2c-tools incus incus-ui lxcfs minicom mkinitcpio mkinitcpio-busybox mosh netavark nomad-driver-containerd nomad-driver-lxc nomad-driver-nspawn nomad-driver-podman nvme-cli pacman pass-otp patatt pdfjs -- Morten Linderud PGP：9C02FF419FECBE16
